setup.title: Welcome to Triage
setup.subtitle: Create the owner account. Only you will sign in here.
login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Triage sorts your requested movies into the right library.
login.throttled: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.

status.title: Status
categories.subtitle: Where each kind of movie goes, and how Triage recognises it.
categories.name: Name
categories.duplicateName: Another category already has this name.
categories.libraryHint: A Radarr root folder. Movies of this category are moved there.
categories.libraryUnavailable: Radarr is not reachable: connect it in Settings to pick a library.
categories.error.unknown_root_folder: This folder is not one of Radarr's root folders.
categories.error.intake_folder: An intake folder cannot be a category's library.
categories.descriptionHint: In plain words: what belongs here. The AI reads it when the rules are not enough.
categories.fallbackHint: Chosen when no other category's signals are present.
categories.rulesHint: Each matching rule adds its weight (1–100). A decisive rule settles the category on its own.
categories.ruleCount: {count, plural, =0 {no rule} one {# rule} other {# rules}}
categories.noLibraryWarning: No library chosen: movies for this category will be held.
categories.emptyDescription: Start from the preset below, or create your own categories.
categories.presetApplied: Categories created. Pick a library for each.
categories.deleteDescription: Past decisions keep it in their history. New movies will no longer go there.
dashboard.subtitle: What Triage sorted recently, and what waits for you.
dashboard.emptyDescription: When a requested movie lands in your intake folder, its decision appears here within a few minutes.
dashboard.week: {count, plural, one {# movie} other {# movies}} sorted in the last 7 days.
dashboard.setupRadarr: Connect Radarr and choose the intake folder
dashboard.setupCategories: Create your categories (a preset is ready)
dashboard.setupScan: Scan the intake folder to preview what Triage would do
decision.metadataHint: What Radarr and TMDB report about the movie, and the rules it matched.
decision.fallbackSignal: No other category had a signal
decision.aiHint: The AI's reading of the movie. It is an interpretation, not a fact.
decision.aiNotAsked: Not asked: the rules were enough, or the AI is off.
decision.aiError: The AI could not answer ({error}). The rules decided alone.
decision.decideHint: Move the movie to a library, or leave it where it is.
decision.correctHint: Move it elsewhere. Triage will never sort this movie on its own again.
reason.no_metadata: Radarr and TMDB report no genre, keyword or company for this movie.
reason.close_second: Two categories are too close (gap under {margin}).
reason.ai_unsure: The AI was not sure either.
reason.category_without_folder: The chosen category has no library yet.
reason.corrected_before: You corrected this movie before: Triage only proposes.
review.subtitle: Movies Triage kept aside, and what it proposes. One tap decides.
review.emptyHeldText: When Triage is not sure where a movie goes, it waits here for you — and you get an email.
review.emptyProposalsText: In preview mode, and after a scan, what Triage would do appears here before anything moves.
review.applyConfidentTitle: Apply {count, plural, one {# proposal} other {# proposals}}?
review.applyConfidentText: Only proposals at or above the confidence threshold are applied. The others stay here.
review.appliedCount: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing applied} one {# movie is being moved} other {# movies are being moved}}
settings.subtitle: Connections, sorting thresholds and notifications.
settings.radarrHint: Where your movies live. Triage only changes the root folder of movies in the intake folder.
settings.intakeHint: The root folder(s) where requests arrive, e.g. “Nouveaux/Non triés”. Save the address and key first to see the folders.
settings.saveRadarrFirst: Save Radarr's address and API key to list its root folders.
settings.tmdbHint: Optional: adds production companies, keywords and age ratings for sharper decisions.
settings.aiHint: Optional: asked only when the rules are not conclusive. Nothing leaves your network.
settings.aiUrlHint: Leave empty to sort with the rules alone.
settings.sortingHint: How sure Triage must be before it moves a movie on its own.
settings.thresholdHint: Below it, the movie waits for you.
settings.margin: Minimum gap between the two best categories
settings.marginHint: Two close categories mean doubt: the movie waits for you.
settings.aiWeightHint: Added to the category the AI chooses, times its confidence.
settings.intervalHint: How often Triage looks at the intake folder. A webhook makes it immediate.
settings.emailHint: Where to send the movies waiting for your decision, with one-click links.
settings.baseUrlHint: Used in email links, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:9393.
settings.seerrHint: Optional: shows who requested a movie and checks the request still follows it after a move.
settings.webhookHint: In the portal: Settings › Notifications › Webhook. Paste this URL, put the secret in “Authorization Header”, enable “Request Approved” and “Request Automatically Approved”.
settings.webhookSecretOnce: Copy it now, it will not be shown again:
mode.title: Mode
mode.subtitle: Start in preview: check Triage's judgement, then let it sort on its own.
mode.previewHint: Triage proposes, you apply. Nothing moves without you.
mode.automaticHint: Confident movies are moved; doubtful ones wait for you.
mode.confirmText: From now on, new movies Triage is sure about are moved without asking. Pending proposals stay for you to apply.
scans.subtitle: Check a whole folder — the intake backlog or one of your libraries. A scan only proposes; you apply.
scans.folderHint: Any Radarr root folder. Movies already in their place are shown as such.
scans.emptyText: Start with the intake folder to see what Triage would do with the movies already waiting there.
scans.applyConfident: Apply the {count, plural, one {confident proposal} other {# confident proposals}}
history.subtitle: Every decision, with its reasons. Open one to correct it.
history.emptyText: Change the filters, or wait for the next requested movie.
status.subtitle: Connected services, the worker, and anything that needs attention.
status.folder.missing: “{category}”: {path} is no longer a Radarr root folder.
wizard.title: Set up Triage
wizard.reopenHint: Walks through the connections, the intake folder, the categories and the mode again. Nothing is lost.
wizard.welcome.title: Welcome
wizard.welcome.text: A few steps and Triage sorts your new movies on its own. You can change everything later in Settings.
wizard.welcome.point1: Connect Radarr and pick the folder where requested movies arrive.
wizard.welcome.point2: Choose the libraries your categories sort into.
wizard.welcome.point3: Optionally add TMDB, a local AI, email and your request portal — each with a test button.
wizard.radarr.title: Radarr
wizard.radarr.text: Triage moves movies through Radarr. Its address and API key are enough; test them before going on.
wizard.intake.title: Intake folder
wizard.intake.text: The Radarr root folder where requested movies land before they are sorted (e.g. "Nouveaux"). Triage only ever touches movies in these folders.
wizard.intake.unreachable: Radarr cannot be reached with the saved settings. Go back and test the connection.
wizard.categories.title: Categories
wizard.categories.text: Each category sorts into one Radarr library. Pick the library for each of them.
wizard.categories.presetText: Two ready-made categories with their rules: animation (genres, studios, keywords) and everything else. You can edit them or add your own later.
wizard.categories.later: Rules, descriptions and new categories are edited in Categories.
wizard.tmdb.title: TMDB
wizard.tmdb.text: Adds every production company and age rating to what Radarr already knows. Free key at themoviedb.org.
wizard.tmdb.hint: The v3 API key (or a read access token).
wizard.ai.title: Local AI
wizard.ai.text: An Ollama server that settles the movies the rules are unsure about. Without it, those movies wait for you.
wizard.ai.modelHint: Test the address to list the installed models.
wizard.email.title: Email
wizard.email.text: When Triage is unsure, it emails you the movie with one-click choices.
wizard.seerr.title: Overseerr / Jellyseerr
wizard.seerr.text: Shows who requested each movie, and its webhook makes sorting immediate.
wizard.finish.title: Ready
wizard.finish.text: Choose how Triage starts. Preview mode only proposes; you switch to automatic when you trust it.
wizard.finish.scanHint: Shows what Triage would do with the movies already waiting there. A scan never moves anything.
undo.title: Undo moves
undo.text: Every movie goes back to the folder it was moved from, through Radarr. Triage then only proposes for them: it never sorts them again on its own. Your own corrections are left as they are.
undo.none: No move to undo for this period.
undo.started: {count, plural, one {# movie is going back} other {# movies are going back}}
verdict.held: Triage is unsure — its best guess
verdict.left_in_intake: Left in the intake folder — best guess
verdict.superseded: Replaced by a newer decision — it was
verdict.simulated: With today's rules it would go to
verdict.corrected: Corrected afterwards — it had gone to
why.title: Why this decision
why.fallback: No other category had a signal, so {category} by default.
why.aiIgnored: The AI chose {category}, but your exclusion rule “{rule}” rules it out: its opinion did not count.
sheet.title: The movie
settings.aiAsk.when_unsureHint: The AI settles only the movies the rules cannot decide. Fast, and the default.
settings.aiAsk.alwaysHint: Every movie also gets the AI's view. If it disagrees with the rules, the movie waits for you. Slower.
settings.aiAsk.neverHint: Rules only: movies the rules cannot decide wait for you.
categories.effect.excludesHint: When it matches, the movie can never go to this category.
sheet.legend: A colored value triggered a rule of the category in that color; a red one rules a category out.
settings.tmdbLanguageHint: The synopsis is shown in this language, and only this country's age ratings are kept (the US ones when it has none). Genres and keywords stay in English, like the rules.
reviewAll.title: {count, plural, one {Decide # movie} other {Decide # movies}}
reviewAll.text: Choose for each movie, then apply everything at once. Proposals start accepted; doubtful movies start on “later”.
reviewAll.summary: {moves, plural, one {# move} other {# moves}}, {others} left or dismissed
reviewAll.done: {count, plural, one {# choice applied} other {# choices applied}}
reanalyze.title: Analyze the intake folder
reanalyze.text: Movies are classified with today's rules, settings and AI. Earlier proposals are replaced, nothing is lost. In automatic mode, the movies Triage is sure of are moved (never the ones you corrected or put back).
reanalyze.started: {count, plural, one {# movie is being analyzed again} other {# movies are being analyzed again}}
activity.title: Activity
activity.subtitle: What Triage is doing now, step by step, and the last jobs.
activity.emptyText: Analyses, moves and scans will show up here as they run.
activity.idle: Triage is idle: nothing has run since it started.
reanalyze.scope.allHint: Every movie in the intake folder: waiting, put back, never analyzed.
reanalyze.scope.waitingHint: The proposals and the movies to decide, again with today's rules.
reanalyze.scope.newHint: Movies never analyzed, or put back in the intake folder (undone moves) since their last analysis.
